messages:
Tess: Quick check-in - Lodestar cohort accepted preview invites. Two ops asks: streamline onboarding flow and capture adoption signals for renewal.
Ravi: Noted. Any immediate friction?
Lydia (Lodestar): Our engineers saw errors accepting invites when provisioning seats via SCIM. Pulled logs into SUP-1102.
Marco: I'll take SUP-1102. Likely attribute mapping. Can Lydia drop the exact SCIM payload?
Lydia (Lodestar): Pasted minimal payload in the ticket. Felt like groupName vs displayName mapping.
Ravi: For adoption signals, propose: immediate 'setup success' ping, 7-day active user count, and feature-usage event for workflows. Keep surveys tiny.
Tess: Agree. Immediate question: "Did setup complete? (Yes/No)" 7-day: WAU metric and top 2 features used.
Marco: SCIM fix ETA: patching attribute map now, will test staging.
OpsBot: Ticket SUP-1102 updated, status: triage -> in_progress.
Lydia (Lodestar): Also can we get weekly CSV with WAU + recent tickets + survey rollup for our PM?
Tess: Yes, we'll add FEED-83 weekly export Fridays. Include ticket links and basic cohort NPS.
Marco: Patch passed staging tests. ETA prod ~2 hours. Will update ticket.
Ravi: Renewal trigger: cohort preview is 3 months. If WAU <6 by week 5 or feature-usage <10 workflows/week, schedule enablement workshop. I'll create ALERT-17.
Lydia (Lodestar): We'll aim for 12 WAU, will share internal onboarding notes Monday.
Tess: Assign owners: Marco -> SCIM patch & ticket; Ravi -> alerts + survey events; Tess -> feed export & workshop POA. Closing for now, reopen if issues.
